v.text: Prince's Island was never named after a prince.
v.said: Prince's Island was never named after a prince.
v.heard: Prince's Island was never named after a prince.

v.text: It's named after a lumberman from Quebec, Peter Anthony Prince.
v.said: It's named after a lumberman from Quebec, Peter Anthony Prince.
v.heard: It's named after a lumberman from Quebec, Peter Anthony Prince.

v.text: His company dug a channel to float logs in from Kananaskis, and that channel cut off an island.
v.said: His company dug a channel to float logs in from Canuhnasskiss, and that channel cut off an island.
v.heard: His company dug a channel to float logs in from Kananaskis, and that channel cut off an island.

v.text: Today the channel is the lagoon. And near it, he built Calgary's first hydro-electric plant.
v.said: Today the channel is the lagoon. And near it, he built Calgary's first hydro-electric plant.
v.heard: Today the channel is The Lagoon, and near it, he built Calgary's first hydroelectric plant.
